fishing: WHEN: Sat Oct 17 evening, prefer early light/moving water dawn before afternoon wind/rain/storms; king tides and residual dirty water from prior systems still challenging. PASSES-BEACH: limited reports due to weather/wind; snook slowing. LEMON BAY: mangrove snapper around Chadwick Park pier and docks, redfish & small snook around random docks/mangroves, trout on flats (Fishin Franks Oct 9). NEARSHORE: weather-limited, few opportunities; possible mangrove snapper on reefs. Baits: live shrimp, gold spoons, soft plastics, pilchards, cutbait.
redtide: FWC Oct 16: K. brevis at background concentrations in 6 samples from and offshore of Southwest Florida (incl. in/offshore Sarasota, offshore Hillsborough). No fish kills or respiratory irritation reported over the past week.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD ~20 CFU/100mL (DOH Charlotte Healthy Beaches, latest sample). No advisory. Palm Island also GOOD.
fpl: Charlotte ~4 customers out; Sarasota ~23 out (recent aggregator data ~Oct 17). No major Englewood spike.
